overview:
Create a premium Russian-language launch/update poster for NebulaGram, portrait 4:5, high resolution, finished publication-ready graphic design. This is a designed marketing poster, not a screenshot and not a photo of a poster.

Input roles: image 1 is the exact NebulaGram brand logo: preserve the white rounded paper-plane silhouette and TWO curved pale-blue speed trails, do not replace with generic Telegram logo. Image 2 is ONLY a design reference for sophisticated large typography, floating translucent interface cards and hierarchy; do not use any TikTok branding, purple palette, v4.2 or its features. Images 3 and 4 show real NebulaGram chat and navigation settings: use their floating capsule geometry and UI visual language, but exclude personal avatars, names and private information.

Art direction: confident contemporary tech editorial, blue palette sampled from NebulaGram logo (#3689e5 to #153f87), deep cobalt background with soft blue atmospheric light, ice-white text, restrained silver-blue highlights, gorgeous layered liquid-glass forms. NOT neon cyberpunk, NOT a busy grid, NO confetti, NO generic stock phone. Lots of clean spacing. A large sculptural frosted glass card/pill in the middle, subtly tilted, carries the exact white NebulaGram plane mark and a tasteful miniature floating bottom-navigation capsule. Below/around it, three impeccably aligned, readable feature blocks with small outline icons. Premium typography similar to a polished Apple product announcement, sharp Cyrillic, no perspective distortion on text. Logo with “NebulaGram” at top; small “ОБНОВЛЕНИЕ ИНТЕРФЕЙСА” eyebrow. Big headline upper third, hero artwork central, short feature summaries lower third, generous margins.

Use ONLY the following exact visible Russian/brand copy, with correct spelling and clear hierarchy:
“NebulaGram”
“ОБНОВЛЕНИЕ ИНТЕРФЕЙСА”
“Твой Telegram.”
“Твой стиль.”
“Liquid Glass”
“Прозрачность, размытие и блики”
“Удобная навигация”
“Папки и нижняя панель под тебя”
“NebulaLink”
“Быстрое подключение с главного экрана”
“На базе Telegram 12.10.1”

Do not claim all bugs are fixed or invent performance/security claims, dates, URLs, version numbers, phone status bars, pricing, extra features or a watermark. The three feature labels should be clearly legible at mobile size, no tiny body text. Harmonious blue-on-blue translucent surfaces, strong contrast white type. Final result: one beautiful coherent poster, not a contact sheet.
